description: The file defines the PubSupervisor class, which manages actor supervision for pub/sub components within an Akka-based system. It handles the creation and management of publisher and updater actors, with behavior for message handling and failure management.

classes.name: PubSupervisor
classes.description: A supervisor actor in an Akka-based pub/sub system, responsible for managing publisher and updater actors, and handling related messaging, behaviors, and failure recovery.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for creating an instance of PubSupervisor with provided distributed data access.

methods.name: createPubSubBehavior
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior for pub/sub messages, specifically handling publication requests.

methods.name: onChildFailure
methods.description: Handles the failure of child actors by resetting the publisher reference.

methods.name: startChildren
methods.description: Initializes child actors for data updating and publishing, storing reference to the publisher.

methods.name: isPublisherAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the publisher actor is currently available.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Forwards the publish message to the publisher actor if available.

methods.name: publisherUnavailable
methods.description: Handles the situation when the publisher actor is unavailable by logging an error.
